_comment: The entire hand-maintained surface of the generated stats. Everything else is derived. Read by tools/build_seasons.py and tools/build_stats.py - this is the single source of truth for manager identity.

rosterCredits.note: Leo managed this team in 2021, so the season is his and not Jay's: the record, the tenure and any playoff games all move. mode 'transfer' removes it from the roster owner; mode 'share' would credit both and is what makes league totals fail to balance. Verified: 2021 roster 4 is the only non-null co_owners in the chain.

curatedPlayoffRecords._comment: Checked against the derived values; the build FAILS on a mismatch. Add to playoffRecordOverrides to accept a curated value instead.

Charlie.why: Curated 6-4 implies an ESPN-era loss that does not exist in either export. 2019 was a week-14 loss to Chaf then two consolation wins; there is no second title-path loss.

Jay.why: Curated 4-3 omits his 2019 run entirely (beat Bij wk14, lost to Stove wk15). 4-3 is exactly 2018 (0-1) plus his Sleeper record (4-2).
